Hero Controls

          

            
Move: WASD or arrows.

            
Sprint: hold Shift.

            
Shoot: hold left mouse.

            
Right Click: use your secondary attack.

            
Main Weapon: locked in before the fight starts.

            
Build: select a card, then place it on the field.

            
Powerups: collect them when they appear.

            
Hotbar: 1-8 use the loadout slots, 9 uses Expedition Surge.

            
Speed: + speeds up, - slows down, T toggles speed.

            
Goal: use the hero and towers together.
